raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

[Proof of concept]

External frontends can own templating and tokenization and only need to inject pre-tokenized requests into the scheduler and get output tokens back. The current embedded Rust server routes these requests through the full frontend. The gRPC handler converts the request and pushes it straight onto the scheduler ring. The scheduler is unchanged.

```
GenerateTokens → from_generate_tokens → DirectIngress::submit
  (vocab check → normalize → register with detok shard → encode → push to ring) → scheduler
responses: existing detok shard → stream; cancel: abort on drop
```

## Accuracy Tests

None yet. It has not been run against a live server. The next step is to compare `GenerateTokens` and `Generate` token ids for the same prompt with `SGLANG_RUST_SERVER=1`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None yet.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code: `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy --tests` are clean for `sglang-server`.
- [x] Add unit tests: 9 new tests cover ring injection, detok registration order, the out-of-vocab rejection, unchecked over-long prompts, the greedy normalize, the full ring, abort on drop, and `UNIMPLEMENTED` without a ring. `cargo test -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types` passes (337 + 21).
- [ ] Update documentation
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance

+/// `GenerateTokens`: one pre-tokenized request mapped field-for-field, with
+/// none of `into_requests`' batch fan-out. Defaults match `GenerateReqInput`'s.
+/// No preferred params or schema defaults: inside a sent `sampling_params`, an
+/// unset `max_new_tokens` means no cap (an absent message takes `Default`'s 128).
+pub fn from_generate_tokens(req: api_v1::GenerateTokensRequest) -> Result<GenerateRequest, Error> {
+    let api_v1::GenerateTokensRequest {
+        rid,
+        input_ids,
+        sampling_params,
+        stream,
+        return_logprob,
+        logprob_start_len,
+        top_logprobs_num,
+        bootstrap_host,
+        bootstrap_port,
+        bootstrap_room,
+        bootstrap_pair_key,
+        decode_tp_size,
+        routed_dp_rank,
+        disagg_prefill_dp_rank,
+        extra_key,
+    } = req;
+    let input_ids = input_ids.map(|ids| ids.ids).unwrap_or_default();
+    if input_ids.is_empty() {
+        return Err(Error::Validation("input_ids cannot be empty".into()));
+    }
+    let sampling_params = sampling_params
+        .map(SamplingParams::try_from)
+        .transpose()
+        .map_err(Error::Validation)?
+        .unwrap_or_default();
+    Ok(GenerateRequest {
+        rid: rid.map_or_else(Rid::default, |r| Rid::from_client(&r)),
+        text: None,
+        input_ids: Some(input_ids),
+        skip_special_tokens: false,
+        sampling_params,
+        stream,
+        return_logprob,
+        logprob_start_len: logprob_start_len.unwrap_or(-1),
+        top_logprobs_num,
+        token_ids_logprob: None,
+        return_sampling_mask: false,
+        return_hidden_states: false,
+        return_text_in_logprobs: None,
+        bootstrap_host,
+        bootstrap_port,
+        bootstrap_room,
+        bootstrap_pair_key,
+        decode_tp_size,
+        routed_dp_rank,
+        disagg_prefill_dp_rank,
+        extra_key: extra_key.filter(|key| !key.is_empty()),
+        mm: None,
+        mm_buffers: Vec::new(),
+    })
+}
